No deterministic rule in audit/check_plan.json inspects caveat content beyond required-topic presence: caveats_declared passes any extra caveat, including one carrying numbers or period comparisons, so caveat text is covered only by auditor judgment at this gate.

gate_release_document.caveats_rendered and claims_rendered are listed under accepted_unproven in audit/check_plan.json, so the release-side caveat checks have never been shown to fire on a broken input.

questions_are_answered compares stated figures with the registry only for R04; the values in analysis/answers/R01.json to R03.json are not compared by any machine rule. They were checked here and match the register.
summary: All five claim values recompute exactly from raw_data/orders.csv and match the register, the metrics registry and the machine recalc (which is rooted only in raw_data). Populations, periods and the paying-customers wording of CLM-REFUND-RATE are correct. One blocker: CLM-NET-REVENUE carries a caveat asserting a 12% rise on the previous quarter, a business figure with no claim_id, no metric and no raw data behind it, since the export holds no row before 2025-01-01.
